ios.desc:
Novaplan is a project planner built around your drawings. Pin tasks and milestones to the floor plan, sketch or sheet they belong to, then switch to a ledger or a live timeline whenever you need the numbers.

PLAN RIGHT ON THE DRAWING
• Pin task cards and milestone diamonds to any spot on a sheet
• Drag dimension lines to change a task's duration
• Dependency connectors show what's waiting on what, with the critical path in orange

FOUR LENSES, ONE PLAN
• Outline: phases and tasks at a glance
• Sheet: your plan on top of the drawing
• Ledger: a fast table of every task, date and day of slack
• Span: a timeline with the critical path and today's line

LITE CAD AND APPLE PENCIL
• Lines, polylines, rectangles, circles, arcs, text and dimensions
• Grid, ortho, endpoint, midpoint and centre snaps
• Real units and scales (mm, cm, m, in, ft-in; 1:50 and more)
• Move, rotate, scale, mirror, offset and trim
• Natural Apple Pencil ink on its own layer
• Export sheets as PDF, SVG or DXF

STAY AHEAD OF CHANGES
• Slip preview: see the new finish date before you commit a delay
• Revisions: snapshot the plan as Rev A, B, C
• See every moved date and re-timed task since the last revision
• Compare a sheet with a revision; ghost cards show where work used to be

FOCUS ON TODAY
• Your Site shows every project's progress, what's due this week and what's overdue
• The Bench holds just three tasks, so you always know what comes next

EVERYWHERE YOU WORK
• Native apps for iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Private iCloud sync between your devices
• Keyboard shortcuts and a command bar on iPad and Mac
• Nebula dark and Daylight light themes
• English, French and Hindi

SUBSCRIPTION
Novaplan requires a subscription: monthly (with a free trial for new subscribers) or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. One subscription unlocks Novaplan on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
